instruction: Set Arial as the default font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Arial as the default font in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify the Standard font name under DefaultFont settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default font name from LibreOffice Writer configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu)
Getter targets the correct XML path (/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont) and property (Standard)
Metric correctly compares extracted font name against expected value 'Arial' using direct string comparison
Metric correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses expected.get('font_name') without attempting to access 'rules' or 'type' keys (correct pattern for type='rule')
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting Arial as default font, evaluator verifies exactly that
Edge case handling: getter returns None if font not set, metric returns 0.0 (correct behavior)
No postconfig needed: configuration file is persistent and doesn't depend on UI state
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts string (font name) -> metric compares string -> returns 1.0 or 0.0
